vars.name: migrate_db
vars.doc: scratch database for the migrations check

baseline.note: most of it the Pest suite

steps.name: snapshots
steps.title: Pest snapshots
steps.cmd: if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain tests/.pest/snapshots)" ]; then echo 'The test run created or changed a snapshot; review and commit it.'; git status --porcelain tests/.pest/snapshots; exit 1; fi

steps.name: migrations
steps.title: Migrations
steps.source: (DB_DATABASE=$migrate_db php artisan migrate --force --no-interaction >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && DB_DATABASE=$migrate_db php artisan db:wipe --force --no-interaction && DB_DATABASE=$migrate_db php artisan migrate --force --no-interaction

steps.name: openapi
steps.title: API contract
steps.cmd: php artisan scramble:export --path=openapi.json && git diff --exit-code openapi.json

steps.name: env
steps.title: Environment
steps.source: base=\$(git merge-base $env_base HEAD) || { echo \"no merge base between $env_base and HEAD\"; exit 1; }; for name in \$(git diff \"\$base\"..HEAD -- app config routes database bin | grep '^+' | grep -v '^+++' | grep -oE \"env\\(['\\\"][A-Z0-9_]+\" | sed -E \"s/^env\\(['\\\"]//\" | sort -u); do grep -qE \"^\$name=\" .env.example || echo \"\$name is read by the change but not in .env.example\"; done
